thread.title: Zohran Mamdani to Become First New York Mayor to Take Oath on Quran
thread.title_full: Zohran Mamdani to Become First New York Mayor to Take Oath on Quran

author: Associated Press Television News
title: Zohran Mamdani to Become First New York Mayor to Take Oath on Quran
text:
•	Zohran Mamdani will be sworn in as New York City's mayor on a Quran.
•	This marks the first time a New York City mayor will use Islam’s holy text for the oath.
•	Mamdani will be the first Muslim, South Asian, and African-born person to hold the position.
•	The inauguration will take place in a long-closed subway station beneath City Hall.
•	Mamdani will use his grandfather’s Quran and a pocket-sized Quran from the New York Public Library’s Schomburg Center for Research in Black Culture during the subway ceremony.
•	For a subsequent ceremony at City Hall, he will use his grandfather’s and grandmother’s Qurans.
•	The pocket-sized Quran dates back to the late 18th or early 19th century.
•	The Quran from the Schomburg Center was acquired by Arturo Schomburg, a Black Puerto Rican historian.
•	The Quran has a deep red binding with a simple floral medallion and is written in black and red ink.
•	The decision to use a Quran has drawn criticism from some conservatives.
•	Following the inauguration, the Quran will be on public display at the New York Public Library.
